messages:
marta: Heads up — nightly e2e smoke failed the throughput gate on batch-heavy profile. p95 jumped ~2.2x compared to baseline. anyone on call to triage? :eyes:
alex: I can take a look in ~10m, pulling logs now. Which job did it tripping?
marta: job: nightly-e2e-batching-2026-03-15 (runner 12). CI mentioned "batcher stall" in logs.
suresh: saw a few queued runners in k8s events earlier, maybe node pressure. grabbing kube events.
ci-bot: [notification] job nightly-e2e-batching-2026-03-15 failed gate: throughput_p95 > threshold (2.2x). artifacts: https://ci.redwood/test/artifacts/1768504321
dina: I kicked a quick /rerun-single for the job to confirm flakiness — rerun queued.
alex: quick grep of the artifact shows a lot of "batcher waiting for kv cache" lines around 00:12:34. snippet:
```
[runtime] batcher: waiting for KV hit, seq=512, waiting_clients=18
[worker] slow_commit: write latency spike 120ms
```
ben: that seq length looks odd for the smoke profile — usually <256. Could be a test generator bug.
suresh: kube events show several OOMKilled on runner-12 around the same time. suspect memory pressure caused batching delays.
infra-bot: [alert] host g4-12 restarted at 2026-03-15T00:11:50Z — reason: oom_kill. Investigating underlying instance metrics.
alex: if it's OOM -> batching stalls -> latency spike. But need to confirm root cause (test change vs infra).
marta: is there a PR that changed the longseq profiles or the generator? @ben any recent edits?
ben: merged small tweak to longseq-gen two days ago that bumped default seq to 512 for certain paths — I thought only for perf suites. Reverting now to test if it helps.
dina: rerun completed: still red but p95 delta smaller (1.4x). So partially flappy.
suresh: infra metrics show memory usage jumped on those hosts from 60% to 92% before oom. No other noisy tenants. Could be the heavier seq.
alex: can we run localized repro: set seq=512 on a canary runner and watch batching telemetry? I can spin up a dev runner.
marta: yes please. Also can someone run a bisect on the nightly pipeline to find first green->red commit range? if it's the generator change that'll be quick.
ben: starting bisect across nightly branches now, will post first bad commit.
infra-bot: [action] spun up dev-runner x-small with seq=512, model=redwood-v1-quant, region=us-west2. Link: https://ops/redwood/dev/runner/122
alex: running the local e2e with same input set. ETA ~12m.
dina: pinging owners of the longseq-gen PR for context @ben
ben: confirmed my PR intentionally set seq higher for perf harness only; I forgot to scope the selector. My bad — sending revert patch.
suresh: bisect log: first bad at commit sha abc123 -> introduced longseq default change (ben).
marta: great find, ben revert + rerun should clear. ben can you open hotfix PR and mark as urgent?
ben: opened PR #4123, title: revert longseq default bump. CI: https://ci.redwood/pr/4123/status
dina: will kick another rerun once PR is merged.
alex: local dev run with seq=512 reproduces p95 spike + "batcher waiting for KV hit" — confirming behaviour.
marta: plan: revert PR -> merge -> rerun nightly. If still red, escalate infra. If green, we schedule a follow-up to move perf-only config out of default.
ben: merged revert.
dina: /rerun-nightly job queued after merge.
ci-bot: [notification] PR #4123 merged by ben.
ci-bot: [notification] rerun triggered: nightly-e2e-batching-2026-03-15 (rerun id 1768507700).
infra-bot: host oom restarts have decreased after runner pool spin-up, monitoring for 30m.
dina: rerun finished: gate passed. p95 within 1.02x baseline. :tada:
marta: thanks all — leaving this thread open for any follow-ups. Action items: ben to open a follow-up to scope perf config, infra to add mem headroom alert, alex to add a short repro doc.
ben: will create follow-up ticket and link PRs.
infra-bot: [note] created alert mem-headroom-low (severity: low) for runner pool.
alex: drafting repro doc now, will drop link in #eng-runtime.
marta: awesome. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
